content.text: In Kenya, where Stripe and PayPal are heavily restricted, creators struggled to earn from international buyers. When conventional options failed, a digital commerce infrastructure company, COREMERCH, stepped in to deliver a sovereign digital commerce stack. In this case study, we'll explore how one Kenyan creator successfully deployed a sovereign digital commerce stack using the Edge Commerce Stack and NOWPayments.
The Situation Before the Stack

Before the Edge Commerce Stack, our Kenyan creator had tried various conventional payment options, such as Stripe and PayPal, but due to restrictions, they were unable to receive payments from international buyers. This limiting factor significantly impacted their business, as they could only sell to local customers. They needed a solution that would break free from these geographical barriers and enable them to reach a global audience.
Why Conventional Options Had Already Failed

Conventional payment options, such as Stripe and PayPal, were not only restricted in Kenya but also came with steep fees, complex onboarding processes, and limited features. The restrictions and fees made it difficult for our creator to scale their business and reach international buyers. The lack of control over their digital commerce infrastructure also meant that they were vulnerable to platform outages and changes in payment policies.
The Infrastructure That Was Deployed

The Edge Commerce Stack, deployed by COREMERCH, was the solution our creator needed. This stack consisted of Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. With this infrastructure, our creator could host their digital products, process payments, and deliver products to customers instantly. The Edge Commerce Stack also provided end-to-end testing, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, and 30-day support, giving our creator peace of mind and the ability to scale their business.
Kenyan creators can now earn from international buyers with a sovereign digital commerce stack.
What Happened After Going Live

After deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, our creator was finally able to receive payments from international buyers. The NOWPayments integration enabled automatic crypto payment verification, ensuring that transactions were secure and reliable. The instant product delivery feature allowed customers to access their purchased products immediately, resulting in high customer satisfaction. With the Edge Commerce Stack, our creator's business flourished, and they were able to reach a global audience.
The Lessons That Apply to Your Situation

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost, under their own accounts, with full data ownership from day one.
